FRONTEND — Visitor Display
User Story ID
QC-HOME-004 | US001 | REF:
FR-004
Title
Latest News Section — Visitor Display
As a
public website visitor
I want
to see the latest Qatar Chamber news articles in a
dedicated section on the Home Page
So that
I can stay informed about the latest news and navigate to
full articles
Preconditions:
- At least one news article is published and active in
the News module.
- The Latest News section is enabled on the Home Page.
Frontend Workflow:
1. Visitor scrolls to the Latest News section on the Home
Page.
2. The section renders with the section tag, heading, and the
most recently published news cards.
3. Each news card displays: thumbnail image, publication
date, headline title, and View count.
4. Visitor clicks a news card — browser navigates to the full
article page.
5. Visitor clicks View All CTA — browser redirects to the
full News listing page.
Given the
visitor scrolls to the Latest News section
When the
section renders
Then
- The system shall display the section tag and heading in
the active language.
- The system shall display the most recently published
news article cards (up to the configured count).
- Each news card shall display: thumbnail image,
publication date, headline title, and View count.
- Clicking a news card shall navigate the visitor to the
full article page.
- The system shall display a view all CTA button;
clicking it shall redirect the visitor to the news listing page.
- The section shall be fully responsive on all screen
sizes.
Edge Case Scenarios:
- If fewer than the expected number of articles are published,
only the available articles shall display.
Negative Scenarios:
- If the News listing page is unpublished, the View All
button shall not appear.
Post Condition:
- Visitor can read latest news previews and navigate to
the full article or News listing page.
BACKEND — Content Source
User Story ID
QC-HOME-004 | US002 | REF:
FR-004
Title
Latest News Section — Content Source
As a
authorized admin user (Site Content Editor)
I want
to manage news articles from the News module so they
automatically appear in the Latest News section on the Home Page
So that
visitors always see the most recently published Qatar
Chamber news on the Home Page
Preconditions:
- Admin user has the appropriate role to manage content
in the News / Press Room module.
Administrator Workflow:
1. Site Content Editor logs into Liferay CMS.
2. Navigates to News module → Create/Edit Article.
3. Enters the article title (bilingual), category,
publication date, thumbnail image, and article body (bilingual).
4. Saves as draft, submits for review, and publishes the
article.
5. System saves and displays a Liferay generic success toast
message.
6. The published article automatically appears in the Latest
News section on the Home Page (sorted by publication date, newest first).
7. To remove an article from the Home Page section the admin
unpublishes it from the News module.
Given the admin
publishes a news article in the News module
When the Home
Page Latest News section renders
Then
- The system shall automatically surface the most
recently published news articles in the Latest News section on the Home Page,
sorted by publication date descending.
- Unpublished or inactive articles shall not appear in
the section.
- The system shall display a Liferay generic success
toast message after each successful publish/unpublish action in the News
module.
Post Condition:
- Published news articles appear automatically in the
Latest News section on the Home Page.
Note: For Section Tag, Title, Description the requirements is generic thorught the Home page.
